title: On Euclidean systems of ray classes
summary: Lenstra introduced the notion of Euclidean ideal classes, and Treatman extended it to Euclidean systems. In this paper, we formulate Euclidean systems for ray classes, and study their basic properties. In particular, we show that every Euclidean system of ray classes generates the corre sponding ray class group.
